prior_summary: Cartesian commands are learned as fresh measured-TCP body-frame corrections, reducing sensitivity to valid predecessor TCP/configuration offsets and intermediate restarts without changing the Diffusion Policy backbone.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the drawer is open, the block remains near demonstrated valid tunnel support, and the main variation is a collision-free predecessor or mid-skill TCP/configuration offset. Object, TCP and joint observations must be finite.
termination_guidance: Hand off after closed-finger object/TCP motion is coupled, object z exceeds 0.16 m outside the tunnel, and fresh local corrections point toward target_pose.
limitations: Feedback deltas can drift globally and are not object-displacement invariant. Two-frame phase inference can mistake grasp state; IK and collision feasibility are not guaranteed and failed-grasp recovery is not demonstrated.
